findings.title: Unauthenticated Wildcard Route Bypass in Middleware
findings.phase: Phase 14: API Route Surface & Edge Function Audit
findings.description: The route '/api/invoices' was registered in PUBLIC_PATHS in middleware.ts with a startsWith matching clause. While the PDF subroute was explicitly protected, any other potential subroute under '/api/invoices/*' could bypass authentication.
findings.impact: Potential unauthenticated access to future or internal invoice API routes.
findings.resolution_summary: Removed '/api/invoices' from PUBLIC_PATHS and eliminated the startsWith wildcard bypass in middleware.ts. Invoices routes now strictly require authenticated session cookies.

findings.title: PostgreSQL search_path Hijacking on SECURITY DEFINER Functions
findings.phase: Phase 13: Database Schema, Indexes & RLS Policy Audit
findings.description: Functions declared with SECURITY DEFINER execute as the database owner. Without an explicit search_path declaration, they risk executing objects in a rogue schema created by an unprivileged user.
findings.impact: Potential privilege escalation in multi-tenant or shared schema environments.
findings.resolution_summary: Audited all 265 SECURITY DEFINER functions across all 116 SQL migration files. Verified that 100% of SECURITY DEFINER functions explicitly declare 'SET search_path = public' or 'SET search_path to public, pg_temp'.

findings.title: UPI Cash Out Modal-Only UX Lacked Dynamic Real-Time Amount Encoding
findings.description: UPI Cash Out was restricted to an overlay modal without live on-screen scannable QR amount encoding or tactile quick denomination buttons, slowing down high-volume cyber cafe cash withdrawals.
findings.impact: Sub-optimal cashier experience and slower customer transaction times.
findings.resolution_summary: Replaced modal with an integrated dual-column terminal featuring real-time vector UpiQrCode generation encoding dynamic amount (upi://pay?pa=...&am=...), ₹100-₹10,000 denomination chips, and eradicated hardcoded fallback account 9011.

findings.title: DMT Beneficiary Enhancer Script DOM Mutation and Field Constraints
findings.description: DMT used a 149-line DOM-mutation enhancer script to inject self-beneficiary buttons and had HTML required attributes on optional beneficiary fields (account, IFSC, UPI ID).
findings.impact: Potential DOM desynchronization in React and blocked form submissions on valid UPI transfers.
findings.resolution_summary: Purged dmt-self-beneficiary-enhancer.tsx from git repository. Added native React [↪ Use Self] quick autofill button. Cleaned HTML required attributes to permit either bank transfer or UPI ID routes.

findings.title: AEPS Workspace Lacked Fast Bank Selection for Rural Banking
findings.description: AEPS cash withdrawal required manual typing of bank names in virtual keyboards, slowing down customer service for common banks like SBI, PNB, and BoB.
findings.impact: Friction and delay during high-speed counter Aadhaar ATM operations.
findings.resolution_summary: Added 1-click tactile selector chips for the Top 10 Indian Banks directly above the bank input, with automatic normalization and alias mapping.

findings.title: Cross-Module Test Assertion Outdated Against Canonical RPC Architecture
findings.phase: Phase 20: Comprehensive Automated QA Suite Development
findings.description: test-cross-module-reconciliation.mjs tested for legacy client-side direct table mutation fallback comments in business components, which were properly removed in favor of fail-closed server RPCs.
findings.impact: False negative test failure during automated reconciliation regression runs.
findings.resolution_summary: Updated assertions 40 and 42 in test-cross-module-reconciliation.mjs to assert fail-closed canonical create_recharge and record_bill_payment RPC execution.
